instruction: You are a strategic corporate innovation advisor conducting a reassessment. Analyse the prior assessment summary, changes since last assessment, and updated survey, then respond with a complete reassessment JSON including score_delta, carry_forward, progress, and comparison_to_previous.

answers.companyDescription: Temperature-controlled logistics provider operating 50 refrigerated trucks and 8,000 m² of cold storage warehousing. Specialize in pharmaceutical and fresh food distribution across Iberia. Evaluating real-time temperature monitoring sensors and predictive cold-chain failure alerting. We operate across multiple locations and have distinct functional leadership for operations, commercial, finance, and technology. Our annual planning process is well-established but can be rigid — mid-cycle innovation funding requires navigating a formal business case approval chain involving 3-4 stakeholders.
answers.pastInitiatives: We have not undertaken any systematic innovation or transformation programs. Our operational model has been largely unchanged for several years. While leadership acknowledges the need to modernize, we have not yet allocated resources, defined ownership, or committed to a timeline for any specific innovation initiative.
answers.strategicGoals: The board has mandated that 25% of revenue should come from products or services that did not exist 3 years ago. This requires us to systematically explore adjacent markets, new customer segments, and alternative monetization models. We are open to both organic build initiatives and strategic acquisitions of small, innovative companies that can serve as diversification platforms.
answers.teamSize: Our R&D function consists of 10-12 engineers organized into two squads: one focused on core product innovation and one on exploratory/new business model prototyping. We also have 2 dedicated data engineers building our analytics infrastructure. Innovation projects follow a lean startup methodology with clear go/no-go criteria at 3-month checkpoints.

input.changes_since_last: Major competitor entered our market. Customer churn rising. Need to accelerate digital transformation.

opportunities.title: Structured Market Expansion and New Service Line Development (Diversification)
opportunities.rationale: The board mandate to derive 25% of revenue from new sources requires systematic structuring. This opportunity focuses on building the governance around market exploration rather than immediate execution, utilizing existing R&D capacity.

first_actions: Establish a dedicated Innovation Steering Committee (ISC) with representation from all functional leadership to own the 25% mandate.
Define and prioritize 3-4 adjacent market segments based on regulatory feasibility and current core expertise (e.g., specific cold chain compliance niches).
Develop a formal, structured incubation pipeline that moves ideas from concept/feasibility through pilot testing.
resources_needed: Legal counsel specializing in international market entry regulations.
Dedicated time allocation (0.5 FTE) from the Head of Strategy.
execution_plan.success_metric: Number of viable, prioritized adjacent markets defined and validated by internal stakeholders within 6 months.

opportunities.title: Advanced Predictive Cold-Chain Risk Management Platform
opportunities.rationale: To combat rising churn and compete with new market entrants, the company must move beyond reactive monitoring. This involves integrating real-time data streams (temperature, location, environmental factors) to predict failure points before they impact cargo.

first_actions: Conduct a technical deep dive into current sensor data gaps and API integration requirements across existing fleet infrastructure.
Develop proof-of-concept models for predictive failure alerting using historical operational data (leveraging dedicated Data Engineers).
Formalize the minimum viable product (MVP) scope focusing on 2-3 most critical, high-value pharmaceutical routes.
resources_needed: Data Science resources (Data Engineering team capacity).
Integration budget for IoT/Sensor data layers.
Operations subject matter expertise to define alert thresholds.
execution_plan.success_metric: Reduction in reported cold-chain incidents attributable to preventable failure alerts by 15% within the first year of deployment.
milestones: MVP Pilot Deployment on 1 Core Route (Month 6)
Formalized SLA for Predictive Alerting System Established (Month 9)

next_steps.action: Establish the Innovation Steering Committee (ISC) and grant it formal governance authority to drive the 25% diversification mandate.
Conduct a comprehensive competitive gap analysis, mapping competitor services against identified critical pain points in the current cold chain process.
Identify and finalize the core data inputs (telemetry, external weather, operational logs) necessary to power the Predictive Cold-Chain Risk Platform.

key_weaknesses: Decision-making remains bottlenecked by the formal committee structure, slowing strategic execution.
Innovation processes are still defined as 'informal,' lacking standardized intake, evaluation, or resource allocation gates.
Lack of systematized customer feedback loops beyond anecdotal input, hindering continuous improvement and market validation.

improvements: Digital maturity has advanced from Level 2 to Level 3, demonstrating tangible investment in data infrastructure.
Budget allocation for innovation increased substantially (from 5% to 10%), signaling board buy-in and increased resource commitment.
A clear strategic mandate (25% new revenue) has been established by the Board, providing necessary focus.
persistent_gaps: The underlying organizational structure and decision flow still lack agility to support rapid diversification initiatives.
Formalizing the transition from 'idea generation' to 'funded prototype' requires developing robust governance (the ISC).
Operational processes remain rigid, necessitating a cultural shift alongside technological upgrades.
achieved_milestones: Successfully upgraded digital maturity level and secured dedicated data engineering capacity.
Formal recognition of diversification as the primary strategic pillar.

comparison_to_previous.key_changes: The company has significantly improved its digital foundation and secured a clear, board-mandated strategic focus on diversification. However, structural barriers in governance remain the primary impediment to executing new market opportunities.
